function: Ability presentation (animations, visual effects and sounds of every ability)
description: The animation, visual effect and sound fields of every ability as the game holds them after loading: the definitions' own settings plus the bindings of the active ability animation catalog (AbilityAnimationBinding.Apply).
inputs: 738 abilities sorted by feat id. settings lists only the fields that differ from the AbilityDetail defaults, as Property=value, sorted by property name; an animation clip is name@duration in seconds.
